items.docs: Demographics Advanced Endpoint will return the aggregated values of the selected demographics variables of the regions falling inside a user provided geometry or travel time/distance boundaries. All the intersecting demographic boundaries will be snapped completely, and user will have option to request these boundaries in response.

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude of the location.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude of the location.

items.docs: Provides the segmentation details around a specified location. GeoLife 'segmentation bylocation' service accepts longitude and latitude as an input to return the lifestyle characteristics of households in terms of their family status, children characteristics, income behaviors, financial preferences and interests.

params.name: address
params.description: The address to be searched.

params.name: country
params.description: 3 letter ISO code of the country to be searched.Allowed values USA,CAN,GBR,FRA,ITA,AUS,DEU.

items.docs: Provides the segmentation details around a specified address. GeoLife 'Segmentation by Address' service accepts address as an input to return the lifestyle characteristics of households in terms of their family status, children characteristics, income behaviors, financial preferences and interests.

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude of the location.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude of the location.

params.name: profile
params.description: Retrieves the sorted demographic data on the basis of pre-defined profiles that can display the top 3 or top 5 results (by location) either in ascending or descending order.Allowed values Top5Ascending,Top5Descending,Top3Ascending,Top3Descending

params.name: filter
params.description: The 'filter' parameter retrieves the demographic data based upon specified input themes.

params.name: valueFormat
params.description: The 'valueFormat' parameter is applicable for few ranged variables where percent & count both are available and filter response based on the input value.

params.name: variableLevel
params.description: The 'variableLevel' retrieves demographic facts in response based on the input value

params.name: boundaryIds

items.docs: Provides the demographic details around a specified address. GeoLife 'byaddress' service accepts address as an input to return a specific population segment's age group, ethnicity, income, purchasing behaviour, commuter patterns and more.

params.name: address
params.description: Address to be searched

params.name: longitude
params.description: Longitude of the location

params.name: latitude
params.description: Latitude of the location

params.name: searchRadius
params.description: Radius within which demographics details are required. Max. value is 52800 Feet or 10 miles

params.name: searchRadiusUnit
params.description: Radius unit such as Feet, Kilometers, Miles or Meters

params.name: travelTime
params.description: Travel Time based on travelMode within which demographics details are required. Max. value is 1 hour.

params.name: travelTimeUnit
params.description: minutes,hours,seconds,milliseconds. Default is meters.Default is minutes.

params.name: travelDistance
params.description: Travel Distance based on travelMode within which demographics details are required. Max. value is 10 miles.

params.name: travelDistanceUnit
params.description: feet,kilometers,miles,meters.  Default is feet.

params.name: travelMode
params.description: Default is driving.

params.name: country
params.description: 3 digit ISO country code (Used in case address is mentioned).

params.name: profile
params.description: Applicable on ranged variables. Returns top sorted result based on the input value.

params.name: filter
params.description: If Y, demographic boundaries are returned in response.

items.docs: Demographics Basic Endpoint will return the aggregated values of the selected demographics variables of the regions falling inside the search radius. All the intersecting demographic boundaries will be snapped completely and user will have option to request these boundaries in response.
